entries.wording: Parcel received at Shenzhen Sorting Centre.
Parcel processed at Shenzhen Sorting Centre.
Parcel departure in Shenzhen Sorting Centre.
Customs inspection has not yet released
entries.note: The origin's export inspection, after the line-haul agent's customs declaration and before its departure and the flight; the destination's customs comes later, uncoded as "Arrive dest customs".

entries.wording: Parcel departure in Transit Facility, Parcel Departure
Parcel is leaving Airport, Parcel Leaving Port
Parcel arrives at Airport, Parcel Arrival

entries.note: An acceptance scan relayed without a code between the sorting centre's processing and its departure, on a parcel to Germany: the journey goes on.
A US last-mile partner's sort after its receipt, relayed without a code.
A US last-mile partner's departure from its facility, relayed without a code.
A US last-mile partner's receipt at a transit facility (code 70), relayed without a code.
The same partner's local facility taking the parcel in before the delivery run, relayed without a code.
The same partner's transit facility taking the parcel in on its way to the local one, relayed without a code.

entries.wording: Your package is being prepared by the sender and will be handed over to us soon
entries.note: A partner's announcement that the sender has not handed the parcel over, relayed without a code; YunExpress's tracker relays it too.
The same partner's move towards the facility that delivers, before the delivery run.
The same move, sent without the full stop.
Relayed without a code: SpeedX's scan 57112 on its way to the delivering facility, at the same second as its coded line.
Relayed without a code: SpeedX's scan 57101 at the delivering facility, at the same second as its coded line.
USPS's notice that the parcel is still moving but behind its expected day, relayed without a code: no failed attempt or problem.

entries.wording: It is currently in transit to the next facility
entries.note: A partner's move between facilities after the flight lands, relayed without a code.

entries.wording: The package is being transferred to the next facility
entries.note: The same partner's next move between facilities, relayed without a code.

entries.wording: The shipment has been processed in the parcel center of origin
entries.note: DHL's parcel centre on a parcel it delivers in Germany, relayed without a code; WanbExpress also sends it under SupplierAndLastMileReceive.

entries.wording: The shipment arrived in the region of recipient and will be transported to the delivery base in the next step.
entries.note: DHL's arrival in the delivery region, before its delivery base, relayed without a code.

entries.wording: The shipment has been postponed and will probably be delivered on the next working day
entries.note: DHL holding the parcel at its delivery base for another day, after its arrival in the region and before the next loading: no round, so no attempt.

entries.wording: The shipment has been loaded onto the delivery vehicle. Delivery is expected to take place today.
entries.note: DHL's delivery round, relayed without a code.
A US last-mile partner's departure from its destination hub, relayed without a code, after its origin hub's receipt and before its warehouse's.
The last-mile partner's warehouse receiving the parcel, after its departure from the destination hub: still on its way to delivery.

entries.wording: In transit along Poste Italiane’s logistic network
Unfortunately, the delivery of the shipment was not possible.
entries.note: DHL's round that did not deliver, hours after the loading; the parcel went back to a parcel centre and out again days later.

entries.wording: Consignee absent, Consignee could not be found.
entries.note: A partner's round that found no one, hours after it took the parcel out; the parcel went to a parcel shop.
The same partner leaving the parcel at a parcel shop or locker for the recipient, after the missed round.

entries.wording: Out for Delivery, Parcel is at courier, delivery expected soon.
entries.note: A partner's courier with the parcel on its round, which WanbExpress files as transit; the missed attempt followed it within hours.
A partner's round, which WanbExpress files as waiting for collection; the delivery followed it within hours.

entries.wording: Shipment arrived to sorting centre / Shipment in the sorting centre
entries.note: A partner's sorting centre taking the parcel in before its round, relayed without a code; WanbExpress also sends it under SupplierAndLastMileReceive.
A Dutch last-mile partner's departure from its sorting centre, relayed without a code beside its own Dutch line coded 200.

entries.wording: Your shipment has arrived at sorting center
entries.note: A last-mile partner's sorting centre taking the parcel in, relayed without a code at the minute its acceptance by the delivery carrier is coded SupplierAndLastMileReceive.
A partner's courier calling the recipient, relayed without a code at the minute of the round that found no one: not a scan.

entries.wording: Your parcel will soon be handed over to us! It is being prepared by the sender.
entries.note: A partner's pre-advice, relayed without a code at the instant of the parcel's data: the sender has not handed the parcel over.
iMile's receipt at its centre in the destination country, relayed without a code.
iMile's arrival at the delivery station, relayed without a code.
A delivery associate named hours before the run.
The driver's run ended before it reached the parcel, so no door was tried: a delay. The parcel goes back to the station.
Back at the delivery station after a run that did not deliver it. After the driver's failed attempt it is that attempt told again, a notice; after a run that never reached the parcel, in transit.

The day booked for the next run after the parcel came back to the station, as iMile writes its "Shipment is scheduled to" line: moves nothing, so the failed attempt stands. Its pattern covers any day.

entries.wording: Parcel is ready for hand over to distributor
entries.note: Without a code, after the sorting centre's departure: the parcel waits to go to the partner that delivers it.

entries.wording: Order information received. We're expecting your parcel to arrive with us.
entries.note: A partner's pre-advice, without a code, at the instant of the parcel's data and before the sorting centre receives the parcel.

entries.wording: Your parcel is on its way to InPost. Please check back for updates
entries.note: InPost's line on a parcel to the UK, without a code, two days before WanbExpress's sorting centre takes the parcel in.

entries.wording: We have your parcel. Please check back for updates
entries.note: InPost's line on a parcel to the UK, without a code, after the parcel on its way to InPost and the day before WanbExpress's sorting centre takes it in.

entries.wording: We'll apply your My Account preferences to this parcel delivery
entries.note: InPost's note on a parcel to the UK that the recipient's account settings apply: not a scan.
The handover to DPD for the last mile, without a code, the day after the destination's customs clearance: in transit, not DPD's acceptance of a new parcel.
The origin's processing centre taking the parcel in, without a code, after the sorting centre's departure and before the line's.
The origin's processing centre collecting the parcel, without a code, between its arrival there and its delivery to the line.
The origin's processing centre sending the parcel on, without a code, before the line coded LinehaulAgencyDeparture.
The destination's customs taking the parcel in, without a code, an hour before the line coded CustomsCleared.

entries.wording: The parcel has been successfully picked up and is being prepared for transportation.
entries.note: The last-mile partner's collection, without a code, two days after the destination's customs clearance: in transit, not a new acceptance.

entries.wording: The parcel is dispatched from the transit center to the next destination
entries.note: The last-mile partner's transit centre sending the parcel on, without a code.

entries.wording: The parcel arrives at the distribution center and is prepared for transport to the next destination.
entries.note: The last-mile partner's distribution centre taking the parcel in, without a code, before its out-for-delivery line.
